HOW TO APPLY USING THE AMPLIFUND SYSTEM
Opportunities with GMS prepended have a NOFO in AmpliFund. NOFOs in AmpliFund have the same content but look slightly different in this system. These NOFOs are using AmpliFund for grant applications. You must have Grantee Portal access.
Also, your organization must be registered in the Grantee Portal.
For help completing these requirements, see the Grantee Portal User Guide.
